name: ez bar 21s
description: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps. Gives your biceps a burn.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
